about.adc.multiplier: The ADC multiplier: how the node works out the battery voltage.
about.adc.multiplier.set: A new ADC multiplier; 0 uses the board's own.
about.advert: Announces the node across the whole mesh.
about.advert.interval: How often the node announces itself.
about.advert.interval.set: Minutes between adverts; 0 turns them off.
about.advertZeroHop: Announces the node to its neighbours only, with no relaying.
about.agc.reset.interval.set: Seconds between AGC resets; 0 turns it off.
about.allow.read.only: Whether a guest may only read.
about.allow.read.only.set: A guest reads only, or may change things.
about.board: The board the node is built on.
about.bridge.enabled.set: Turns the bridge on or off.
about.bridge.source: Where the bridge takes packets from.
about.cad.set: Turns the air check before transmitting on or off.
about.clkreboot: Restarts the node and sets its clock back to 15 May 2024.
about.clockSync: Sets the node's clock from this phone.
about.direct.txdelay: The pause before a direct transmission.
about.dutycycle: How much airtime the node may take.
about.ethStatus: Ethernet state, if the board has it.
about.extra.sf: Extra spreading factors the node listens on.
about.extra.sf.set: Up to three extra spreading factors.
about.fan.set: The fan: auto, on, off or timeout.
about.flood.advert.interval: How often an advert goes through the whole mesh.
about.flood.advert.interval.set: Hours between mesh-wide adverts; 0 turns them off.
about.flood.max.unscoped: The hop limit for packets with no region.
about.flood.max.unscoped.set: Hops for packets with no region.
about.freq: The frequency the node receives and transmits on.
about.gps.set: Turns the receiver on or off, takes time from it, sets the position from it.
about.gpsAdvert: What the node says about its position.
about.int.thresh.set: A new threshold; 0 turns it off.
about.logStart: Starts the log on the node.
about.loop.detect: How the node looks for loops.
about.loop.detect.set: How strictly the node looks for loops.
about.mqtt.letsmesh-eu.set: Turns letsmesh in Europe on or off.
about.mqtt.letsmesh-us.set: Turns letsmesh in America on or off.
about.mqtt.meshcoretel.set: Turns MeshCoreTel MQTT on or off.
about.mqtt.packets: Whether the node sends packets to MQTT.
about.mqtt.packets.set: Turns packet sends on or off.
about.mqtt.raw: Whether the node sends raw packets to MQTT.
about.mqtt.raw.set: Turns raw packets on or off.
about.mqtt.tx: What the node sends to MQTT.
about.multi.acks: Whether acknowledgements go out in a batch.
about.name: The name the node announces.
about.name.set: A new name for the node.
about.neighborRemove: Forgets a neighbour by the prefix of its key.
about.neighbors: Who the node heard in the last hour: prefix, seconds ago, SNR.
about.owner.info: The line about the owner in the node's profile.
about.owner.info.set: New text about the owner; | starts a line.
about.path.hash.mode: How many bytes a path hop takes.
about.path.hash.mode.set: Path hash size: 0 is 1 byte, 1 is 2, 2 is 3.
about.pin: The Bluetooth PIN; 6 digits, or 0 for the default.
about.power: Battery, USB and charging as the board sees them.
about.powersaving.set: Turns power saving on or off.
about.prv.key.set: The node's private key; applies after a restart.
about.pwrmgt.bootmv: The supply voltage when the board started.
about.pwrmgt.source: What the board is powered from.
about.pwrmgt.support: What the board can do about power.
about.radio.fem.rxgain: The external receive amplifier, on boards that have one.
about.radio.fem.rxgain.set: Turns the external receive amplifier on or off.
about.radio.fem.txgain.set: Turns the external transmit amplifier on or off.
about.radio.rxgain: Whether the receiver amplifier is on.
about.radio.rxgain.set: Turns the receiver amplifier on or off.
about.radio.set: New radio settings; they apply after a restart.
about.region: The region tree as the node knows it.
about.region.set: Regions: load, save, the home one, the lists.
about.regionAllow: A region the node lets through.
about.regionDeny: A region the node keeps out.
about.regionList: The allowed or the denied regions.
about.regionPut: Adds a region under a parent.
about.repeat: Whether the node repeats other people's packets.
about.role: The node's role: repeater, room or sensor.
about.rxdelay: The pause between receiving and answering.
about.sensorSet: Writes a value to a sensor.
about.setperm: Rights for a key: the key, then rights 0–3.
about.startOta: Puts the node into over-the-air update mode.
about.tempradio: Temporary radio settings for N minutes, then the old ones.
about.time: Date and time as Unix seconds; the clock only goes forward.
about.timeForce: Time as Unix seconds, even backwards.
about.tz.offset: The time zone offset from UTC.
about.tz.offset.set: A new offset, hours from −12 to 14.
about.ver: The node's firmware and protocol version.
about.web: Whether the web panel is on.
about.web.set: Turns the web panel on or off.
about.web.stats.set: Whether the web panel shows statistics.
about.wifi.enabled: Turns Wi-Fi on the radio on or off.
about.wifi.ip: The address the radio has on Wi-Fi.
about.wifiClear: Forgets the Wi-Fi network saved on the radio.
